related_questions.question: How to get $700 from FEMA?
related_questions.title: There are four ways you can apply for FEMA disaster assistance:
list: Fill out a DisasterAssistance.gov application online.
Apply using the FEMA app. Download the free app from your smart phone's app store.
Apply in person at a Disaster Recovery Center (DRC). Find a DRC near you.

related_questions.question: What is the maximum FEMA payout?

text_blocks.snippet: For Fiscal Year 2024, the maximum FEMA payout for Individuals and Households Program (IHP) assistance is $42,500 for Housing Assistance and $42,500 for Other Needs Assistance, totaling $85,000, according to FEMA. These maximums apply to disasters declared on or after October 1, 2023. FEMA adjusts these amounts annually based on the Consumer Price Index, according to the Federal Register.

The Individuals and Households Program (IHP) provides financial assistance to individuals and households who have unmet needs after a presidentially declared disaster. The program has two main components:

list.title: Housing Assistance:
list.snippet: Helps with repair or replacement of a damaged home, temporary housing, and related expenses.

list.title: Other Needs Assistance:
list.snippet: Covers necessary expenses and serious needs, such as personal property, transportation, medical, dental, funeral, and childcare expenses.

text_blocks.snippet: FEMA's assistance is capped at the maximum amounts, but it can also be reduced based on your insurance coverage and other factors, according to FEMA. For example, if your insurance covers some of the damage, FEMA's payout will be reduced by the amount of insurance coverage.
